reason: Unmaintained notice, not a vulnerability. chrono is locked only through russh-sftp 3.0.1 (unconditional) and russh-util 0.52.0 (wasm32 targets only, not built for qsh). russh-sftp calls chrono only in FileAttributes::from(&Metadata) and protocol::File::new/longname; the qsh SFTP upload uses RawSftpSession init/open/write/close with explicit FileAttributes and reaches neither. Review on any russh-sftp/russh-util pin, new SFTP operation or callsite, or advisory change; replacement is tracked in #618.
